title: Development of AI Model For Precision Anaesthesia Dosage Optimization
content: This research explores the creation of an AI-driven model to improve anesthesia dosage precision, particularly for pediatric patients. Children present unique challenges in anesthesia due to their developing organs and varying metabolism. Traditional methods often rely on generalized guidelines and clinician expertise, which may not adequately address individual variability, especially in pediatrics. To overcome these limitations, this study employs advanced machine learning (ML) techniques, including supervised learning and ensemble methods, to develop predictive models tailored to each patient’s characteristics.
